name: robots/harunteper__auna
title: AuNa Gazebo Ackermann race car
intro: AuNa Gazebo Ackermann race car, adapted from harunteper/auna. It reads `read_velocity_source`; runs `select_velocity_source`, `publish_teleop_velocity` and `stop_velocity_source`. `select_velocity_source`: select one configured multiplexer input source. Selecting OFF stops forwarding and makes the timer publish zero commands; selecting a motion source can immediately re-publish that source's cached last command. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/harunteper__auna --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/robots/harunteper__auna --backend fake --mcp
